name: comp-60
blurb: Textarea field marked as required with an asterisk.
description: A textarea with the required attribute and a red asterisk (*) in the label to indicate it must be filled.
use_when: Multi-line form fields that are mandatory to submit.
avoid_when: The field is optional or you use a different required indicator.
a11y: Label linked to textarea. Asterisk is decorative (part of label text). Required attribute ensures browser validation.
